project_info.title: Ultimate Sup 8.8 Lobang Deal Free Gifts
project_info.style: High-contrast Singapore sports-nutrition promotional banner with black and golden yellow palette
project_info.color_grading: Dominant deep black (#0B0B0B), energetic golden yellow (#FFC700), crisp white (#FFFFFF) accents

main_subject.description: Square 8.8 promo poster for Ultimate Sup. Top left features bold text '8.8 LOBANG DEAL' and 'SPEND $88 = FREE Gifts'. Center-right displays gift packshots: an Ultimate Sup shaker, branded keychain, and supplement sample pouches beside a gift box. Lower zone shows a clean lineup of supplement tubs including ON, Dymatize, BSN, C4, Muscletech, Xtend, Barebells, Raw Nutrition, and Applied Nutrition.
main_subject.action: Product display with promotional offer banner

composition_elements.foreground: Promotional copy badge, gift items, and clear product cutout lineup on a glossy plinth
composition_elements.midground: Golden yellow geometric diagonal panels and subtle confetti accents
composition_elements.background: Deep textured matte black background with soft warm yellow backlighting
composition_elements.depth_of_field: Sharp focus across text, gift bundle, and product lineup

lighting_and_atmosphere.key_light: Bright overhead commercial studio light highlighting tub labels and gift items
lighting_and_atmosphere.fill_light: Warm yellow edge rim light for separation

slide_1.text_in_image: Render only three text lines: top text "8.8 LOBANG DEAL" in large white-and-yellow bold font; subheadline "SPEND $88 = FREE Gifts"; bottom date strip "ONLY: 8:00 07/08 - 23:59 10/08". Show the keychain, shaker, and sample pouches visually without extra text.
slide_1.negative_prompt: blurry text, missing products, wrong brand logo, distorted label text, low contrast, messy layout, watermark, cropped tubs

main_subject.description: Square Ultimate Sup catalog poster. Use the fixed composition: black left brand panel, a torn golden-yellow offer receipt, then three cream product shelf rows. The receipt reads 'Exclusive Brand Deals' and 'SPEND $66 = 1 Brand Merch'. Place six clear packshots in three rows: Mutant Hardcore ISO with PVL ISO GOLD; Ghost Whey with Nutrabio Whey Isolate; Pure Protein with JNX The Curse.

composition_elements.foreground: Torn yellow offer receipt and six front-facing supplement packshots, each large and legible
composition_elements.midground: Three neat cream shelves with a small branded-merch gift graphic at the receipt bottom
composition_elements.background: Matte black left panel transitioning to a clean pale-cream catalog area
composition_elements.depth_of_field: Deep focus keeping all 6 product tubs sharp

lighting_and_atmosphere.key_light: Even frontal studio light providing clear label visibility for every tub
lighting_and_atmosphere.fill_light: Soft golden rim light along product shoulders

slide_2.text_in_image: Render headline: "Exclusive Brand Deals" at top center. Render offer card: "SPEND $66 = 1 Brand Merch". Include labels underneath: "Mutant Hardcore ISO", "PVL ISO GOLD", "Ghost Whey", "Nutrabio Whey Isolate", "Pure Protein", "JNX The Curse".
